tytul: Ginger bug: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for a ginger bug, a fermented ginger starter used to make drinks (Polish zakwas imbirowy).

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to Illinois Extension, its homemade ginger ale, a drink fermented in a closed bottle, is never made in glass: if the bottle stands too long without releasing carbon dioxide, it will explode.
Health Canada names ethanol in non-alcoholic fermented drinks as a concern in kombucha, kefir and some other drinks, including ginger beer.

akapity: Illinois Extension’s homemade ginger ale recipe uses active dry yeast, not a ginger bug.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for a ginger bug from a checked source.
